valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the two P/E routes disagree (market cap over net profit 83.56 against price over EPS 92.00) and the filing does not settle which row is right. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.earnings_yield_withheld_reason: Withheld: the earnings behind the earnings yield are not verified: the two P/E routes disagree (market cap over net profit 83.56 against price over EPS 92.00) and the filing does not settle which row is right. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2024, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pbFormula: current price / book value per share, where book value per share = total equity / shares outstanding
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2024
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 5.17039e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_JSE.json)
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2024, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 5.17039e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_JSE.json)
valuation.peg_withheld_reason: Withheld: the P/E a PEG divides is itself withheld, so there is no P/E to divide by the growth rate. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pb_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (remgrolimited) is served under two keys, REM.JO and REM, that stand on DIFFERENT filings: REM.JO is the fresher period on file, so REM is superseded and withheld while REM.JO publishes the current year. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
